categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h to expose a public C and C++ script evaluation tracer API.
categories.rationale: Exposes an optional script evaluation tracer through the libbitcoinkernel C and C++ API to enable external tooling like script debuggers. While valuable for downstream consumers such as rust-bitcoinkernel and for improving interpreter test inspection, this diagnostic capability is an auxiliary feature rather than essential API completeness for validating blocks or reading chainstate.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Labeled Validation and touches src/script/interpreter.cpp to insert compile-time gated trace callbacks.
categories.rationale: Validation explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API. The PR inserts inactive-by-default trace hooks into EvalScript without substantively changing consensus rules, chainstate invariants, or validation behavior.
